name: baseline
description: The live DocSearch pipeline. Retrieval, chunking, and prompt settings are read from the codebase and mirror production exactly. ONE deliberate deviation: generation runs on gemini-flash-lite-latest rather than production's gemini-flash-latest, whose free tier allows 20 requests/day and cannot complete a 77-question run. Retrieval experiments are therefore valid as production measurements; generation-quality numbers are not. See eval/config/README.md.
